dedupe_keys.name: cyprus greenhouse locations and agricultural plastic waste mapping inputs

description: This deposit maps greenhouse and tunnel locations and covered plot areas across the Republic of Cyprus to support agricultural plastic-waste estimates. Paris Fokaides and collaborators combine Cyprus Agricultural Payments Organization plot records with GIS and satellite interpretation, organising findings into sixteen geographic clusters. The article describes using polyethylene specifications to estimate potential waste generation. Mendeley version 3 lists a shapefile archive and a document, freely available under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is mapped greenhouse structures within the Republic; exact imagery dates and a common reference year were not established in the reviewed metadata. Conversion from covered area to plastic waste depends on material and replacement assumptions, which are limitations for interpreting potential generation as measured disposal. Modellers could use the location and area inputs for waste-collection capacity or treatment-location simulations. data-what-a-waste-global-database provides related waste-system context. Earlier candidates wrongly excluded this reusable agricultural-waste planning input as unrelated single-study data. No shapefile or document was downloaded.
